blocks.tamil_translation: that another man passed by that way. The Prophet ﷺ asked that man, “What is your opinion of this one?” He said, “O Rasulallah, he is a poor Muslim; if he asks for a woman's hand anywhere, she will not be given to him in marriage. If he intercedes for anyone, his intercession will not be accepted, and if he speaks, his speech will not be listened to.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Even if people like the first man filled the whole world, this man is better than all of them.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: رَأَي سَعْدٌ ﵁ أَنَّ لَهُ فَضْلاً عَلَي مَنْ دُونَهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: هَلْ تُنْصَرُونَ وَتُرْزَقُونَ إِلَّا بِضُعَفَائِكُمْ؟
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب من استعان بالضعفاء ...رقم:٢٨٩٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mus'ab ibn Sa'd (RA) narrates: (His father) Hazrat Sa'd (RA) had the thought that he had excellence and superiority over the Sahabah who were of a lower standing than him (in wealth and in bravery). The Prophet ﷺ said, “It is only through the barakah of the weak and helpless among you that you are helped and that your needs are fulfilled” (and thereby corrected his thinking).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: اِبْغُونِي الضُّعَفَاءَ فَإِنَّمَا تُرْزَقُونَ وَتُنْصَرُونَ بِضُعَفَائِكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الانتصار ... رقم:٢٥٩٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Seek me among the weak, for it is only because of the weak among you that your needs are fulfilled and that you are helped” — that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this,
